title: Parallel Lines & Angle Rules
welcome_lead: When a line crosses parallel lines, magical angle pairs appear. Master them all.
meta_desc: Master parallel line angle rules in this KS3 geometry adventure.
final_note: Excellent! Parallel-line angles are clear and easy now.

concepts.def: Lines that never meet, always same distance apart.
A line crossing two or more parallel lines.
Equal angles in a Z-shape between parallel lines.
Equal angles in an F-shape on parallel lines.
Angles inside parallel lines summing to 180°.
Equal angles across a crossing point.

walkthroughs.body_html:
When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, corresponding angles are equal.

Look for an F-shape — the matching corners are equal.

Alternate angles between parallel lines are equal.

Spot a Z-shape — the two angles on opposite sides of the transversal are equal.

Co-interior angles on the same side of a transversal sum to 180°.

If one is 110°, the other is 180 − 110 = 70°.
